name: Agent Threads
author: Adam Ritter
description:
This plugin is a Herdr replacement that uses native windows so that I don't have to learn extra key bindings for window management.

It's a keyboard-controlled sidebar for tracking and opening local or remote Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode threads in native windows.

I use Super+S to show/hide the sidebar on my system and Super+A to switch to it and quickly select another thread. It can show when a thread is busy/not, supports threads/projects/remoting, pinning, vi like keybindings for navigation and it's super fast.

The sidebar can be enabled/disabled either globally or selectively for each workspace.

You can create new projects, rename threads, and it will remember everything at the next startup. It integrates deeply with both Hyprland and Codex/Claude/OpenCode, so you can see the sessions opened by the native programs (and all your remote sessions).

barWidget.description: A keyboard-first session browser for Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode.
